# AI Specialist 2.0 by ClaimSkills.ai – complete description (India edition)
Last updated: 2026-09-14 · Canonical URL: https://india.claimskills.ai/

## Format
Live orientation by the founders on 19 September 2026 (8 PM IST, Hindi + English), then five recorded academies unlocked in the LMS (lms.claimskills.ai) for self-paced learning over 28 days, plus a weekly live AI Mastermind session. LMS access lasts 1 year (₹999 annual subscription). Class recordings are unlocked in the LMS after the live orientation.

## One-paragraph answer
AI Specialist 2.0 by ClaimSkills.ai (Canadian Labs of AI and Management, CLAIM) is a 28-day certified, practical AI course for beginners in India and worldwide, offered in association with Barleti University, an accredited European institution. It costs ₹999 (a 99% discount on the ₹1,09,800 combined value of its four academies), has 6,000+ enrolled learners and a 4.8/5 rating on Trustpilot. The September 2026 batch begins with a live orientation by the founders on 19 September 2026 at 8:00 PM IST in Hindi and English; five recorded academies then unlock inside the LMS (lms.claimskills.ai).

## Curriculum (5 academies)
1. AI Marketing, Meta & WhatsApp Academy (market value ₹19,950; official fee ₹19,950, list ₹39,950). Outcome: turn attention into leads and buyers. Topics: offers, AI-assisted ad and page copy, funnels, buyer psychology, WhatsApp automation and follow-up agents.
2. AEO – Answer Engine Optimization Academy (₹24,950; list ₹39,950). Outcome: learn how AI engines find, read and recommend content. Topics: AI search behaviour, schema markup, AI-ranked content, llms.txt, social discoverability.
3. AI Agent & Automation Academy (₹29,950; list ₹59,950). Outcome: replace repeated manual work with systems. Topics: workflow mapping, lead generation and delivery stacks, packaging automation services.
4. AI Software Academy (₹34,950; list ₹54,950). Outcome: turn ideas into AI-powered tools. Topics: prompting, niche AI tools, chatbots, custom no-code AI apps, AI agents.
5. Bonus: AI Content Creator & Avatar Academy (₹15,950; list ₹24,950). Outcome: create content faster without losing quality. Topics: authority content, multi-channel content, visual assets, content factory.
Total stack value ₹1,09,800. Price ₹999 (annual subscription access).

## FAQ
Q: Is the AI Specialist program live or recorded?
A: The batch starts with a live orientation by the founders on 19 September 2026 at 8:00 PM IST in Hindi and English. After it, five recorded academies (AI Marketing, AEO, AI Agent & Automation, AI Software, and the AI Content Creator bonus) are unlocked in the LMS at lms.claimskills.ai for self-paced learning over 28 days.

Q: Do I need a tech or AI background to join the AI Specialist course?
A: No. The program is built for beginners: students, working professionals, business owners, freelancers and agencies. No coding is required; AI apps are built with no-code tools.

Q: What certificate do I get from ClaimSkills.ai?
A: On completion you receive the Certified AI Specialist certificate from CLAIM (Canadian Labs of AI and Management) in association with Barleti University, an accredited European institution. Each certificate has a unique ID verifiable at claimskills.ai/verify.

Q: How much does the AI Specialist 2.0 course cost in India?
A: The complete stack costs ₹999 (INR), a 99% discount on the ₹1,09,800 combined value of the four academies (₹19,950 to ₹34,950 each when sold separately), plus the Content Creator bonus academy worth ₹15,950. Payment is via Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking).

Q: What happens after I pay for the ClaimSkills AI course?
A: You land on a confirmation page with the WhatsApp community link, and your LMS login ID and password are emailed to you. Recordings and all academies are inside the LMS portal.

Q: Is there a refund on the ₹999 AI Specialist offer?
A: No. ₹999 is a limited-time offer price and is not covered under the refund policy. The Cancellation and Refund Policy is linked in the footer.
